# 1 Samuel Chapter 22 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 163v–164r | **Source Image:** 1SA_022_page_001.jpg, 1SA_022_page_002.jpg

---

**22:1** And-David went from-there and-escaped to-[the]-cave of-Adullam. And-his-brothers heard and-all [the]-house of-his-father, and-they-went-down to-him there.

**22:2** And-gathered to-him every man [in]-distress and-every man who [had]-a-creditor and-every man bitter of-soul [mar nefesh], and-he-became over-them [as]-commander. And-there-were with-him about four-hundred men.

**22:3** And-went David from-there to-Mizpeh of-Moab, and-said to-[the]-king of-Moab, "Let-come-out, please, my-father and-my-mother with-you, until I-know what God will-do for-me."

**22:4** And-he-led-them before the-king of-Moab, and-they-dwelt with-him all the-days [that]-David-was in-the-stronghold.

**22:5** And-said Gad the-prophet to-David, "Do-not dwell in-the-stronghold. Go and-come for-yourself to-[the]-land of-Judah." And-went David and-came to-[the]-forest of-Hereth.

**22:6** And-heard Saul that David was-known, and-the-men who [were]-with-him. And-Saul [was]-sitting in-Gibeah, under the-tamarisk-tree [eshel] on-the-height, and-his-spear [was]-in-his-hand, and-all his-servants [were]-standing upon-him.

**22:7** And-said Saul to-his-servants, the-[ones]-standing upon-him, "Hear, please, Benjaminites. Will-also the-son of-Jesse give to-all of-you fields and-vineyards? Will-he-make all of-you commanders of-thousands and-commanders of-hundreds?

**22:8** For you-have-all conspired against-me, and-there-is-no-one uncovering my-ear when-my-son cuts-[a covenant] with-the-son of-Jesse. And-there-is-no-one from-you who-is-sick on-my-account or-who-uncovers my-ear, for my-son has-raised-up my-servant against-me, to-lie-in-wait as-this day."

**22:9** And-answered Doeg the-Edomite — and-he [was]-standing over [the]-servants of-Saul — and-said, "I-saw the-son of-Jesse coming to-Nob, to-Ahimelech son of-Ahitub.

**22:10** And-he-inquired for-him of-YHWH, and-provisions he-gave to-him, and-the-sword of-Goliath the-Philistine he-gave to-him."

**22:11** And-the-king sent to-call Ahimelech son of-Ahitub, the-priest, and-all [the]-house of-his-father, the-priests who [were]-in-Nob. And-they-came all-of-them to-the-king.

**22:12** And-said Saul, "Hear, please, son of-Ahitub." And-he-said, "Here-I-am, my-lord."

**22:13** And-said to-him Saul, "Why have-you-conspired against-me, you and-the-son of-Jesse, in-your-giving to-him bread and-a-sword, and-inquiring for-him of-God, to-rise against-me, to-lie-in-wait as-this day?"

**22:14** And-answered Ahimelech the-king and-said, "And-who among-all your-servants [is]-as-faithful [ne'eman] as-David, and-son-in-law of-the-king, and-captain over your-bodyguard, and-honored in-your-house?

**22:15** Did-I-begin today to-inquire for-him of-God? Far-be-it from-me! Let-not-the-king set a-thing against-his-servant, against-all [the]-house of-my-father, for your-servant knew nothing of-all this, small or-great."

**22:16** And-said the-king, "You-shall-surely-die, Ahimelech, you and-all [the]-house of-your-father."

**22:17** And-said the-king to-the-runners, the-[ones]-standing upon-him, "Turn and-put-to-death the-priests of-YHWH, for also their-hand [is]-with-David, and-for they-knew that he-was-fleeing and-did-not uncover my-ear." But-the-servants of-the-king were-not willing to-stretch-out their-hand to-strike against-the-priests of-YHWH.

**22:18** And-said the-king to-Doeg, "You turn and-strike against-the-priests." And-turned Doeg the-Edomite and-he struck against-the-priests. And-he-put-to-death on-that day eighty-five men bearing [a]-linen ephod.

**22:19** And-Nob, the-city of-the-priests, he-struck with-[the]-edge of-the-sword, from-man and-unto woman, from-child and-unto suckling, and-ox and-donkey and-sheep — with-[the]-edge of-the-sword.

**22:20** And-escaped one son of-Ahimelech son of-Ahitub, and-his-name [was] Abiathar, and-he-fled after David.

**22:21** And-told Abiathar to-David that Saul had-killed the-priests of-YHWH.

**22:22** And-said David to-Abiathar, "I-knew on-that day, when Doeg the-Edomite [was]-there, that he-would-surely tell Saul. I have-caused [the death of]-every soul of-[the]-house of-your-father.

**22:23** Dwell with-me; do-not fear, for whoever seeks my-life seeks your-life, for you [are]-a-charge [mishmereth] with-me."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

1. **22:2 — mar nefesh**: "Bitter of soul" — David gathers the disenfranchised. This band of 400 malcontents becomes the nucleus of his future army and administration.

2. **22:17 — "the servants of the king were not willing"**: The royal guard refuses to kill YHWH's priests — a profound moment of moral resistance to royal authority.

3. **22:18 — "eighty-five men bearing a linen ephod"**: Doeg the Edomite does what Israelites refused to do. The irony is devastating: the cherem that Saul failed to execute on Amalek (ch.15) he now executes on YHWH's own priests.

4. **22:19 — Nob's destruction**: The language deliberately echoes the cherem formula from ch.15:3 ("from man unto woman, from child unto suckling, ox and donkey and sheep"). What Saul spared in Amalek he destroys in Israel.

— EMET
